definition: Defines the objectives, principles, scope and preferred service or deployment models for cloud adoption.
Assesses applications, infrastructure, data, skills, costs, security and institutional readiness for cloud.
Defines the target cloud architecture, workload disposition and sequenced adoption or migration roadmap.
Establishes governance, roles, skills, service management, financial management and provider management for cloud.
Creates a cross-functional capability to define standards, support adoption and oversee cloud implementation.
